g.text: USB cable to the laptop (power and code)
in the tank lid, facing the food
Column map of the whole feeder:
NUCLEO PINS: each tag on the board is a wire from that hole to this pin
PF15 · D2 · CN10 pin 12: driver EN, column 5 b
PE9 · D6 · CN10 pin 4: driver STEP, column 11 c
PF13 · D7 · CN10 pin 2: driver DIR, column 12 d
PF14 · D4 · CN10 pin 8: HX711 DAT, column 16 d
PE13 · D3 · CN10 pin 10: HX711 CLK, column 17 c
PA4 · D24 · CN7 pin 17: amplifier LRC, column 15 g
PC10 · D45 · CN8 pin 6: amplifier BCLK, column 16 i
PC12 · D47 · CN8 pin 10: amplifier DIN, column 17 h
PD14 · D10 · CN7 pin 16: HC-SR04 Trig, column 25 h
PD15 · D9 · CN7 pin 18: Echo after the divider, column 26 c
PC6 · D16 · CN7 pin 1: to ESP32-CAM RX via 1 kΩ, column 29 h
PC7 · D21 · CN7 pin 11: from ESP32-CAM TX, column 33 g
PB8 · D15 · CN7 pin 2: I2C SCL bus, column 31 d
PB9 · D14 · CN7 pin 4: I2C SDA bus, column 32 e
PE11 · D5 · CN10 pin 6: microSD CS, column 42 f
PA5 · D13 · CN7 pin 10: microSD SCK, column 43 g
PB5 · D22 · CN7 pin 13: microSD MOSI, column 44 h
PA6 · D12 · CN7 pin 12: microSD MISO, column 45 i
PG14 · D1 · CN10 pin 14: LED through 330 Ω, column 44 d
PF12 · D8 · CN7 pin 20: button, column 49 e
Power wires drawn in full: 3V3 (R2), GND (R3), both GND rails joined (R4).
1. A dot with a white ring is a wire end in that hole.
2. A tag such as PE9 at a hole: a wire from that hole to that Nucleo pin.
3. Parts outside the board join it with female to male wires.
4. Every part has its own picture with all its wires drawn
in full: circuits 1 to 10 in circuits_by_part.
5. Rails: top + 5 V, bottom + 3.3 V, both − GND; 12 V only
in column 5 (red frame) and on the XL4015 input.
1. Rails R2, R3, R4. No R1: the XL4015 feeds the 5 V.
2. Power (circuit 7): set the XL4015 to 5.0 V first.
3. Driver and motor (1), scale (2): first milestone.
5. Clock and tank sensor (8), microSD (9), button and LED (10).
6. Test each part before adding the next one.
7. Check every Nucleo pin label before plugging.
Tests: Nucleo on the laptop USB (JP3 on U5V).
On: USB, then the adapter. Off: adapter first.
Feeder alone: add P6 (top + rail to E5V,
circuit 7) and set JP3 on E5V; adapter only.
Never R1 and the XL4015 at the same time.
Never plug or unplug the motor with 12 V on.
Wire P6 for the feeder alone:
